Structurally, it integrates the triad concerning the visible (*sanidassanattika*) with the dyad concerning states that are not roots but are accompanied by roots (*nahetusahetukaduka*), methodically examining their conditional relations according to the analytical framework of the *Paṭṭhāna*.
